name: Battle of Hillsbrad
summary: Battle of Hillsbrad is a Forsaken military mission directed by High Executor Darthalia from Tarren Mill. Following the initial strikes on the northern human farms, Horde operatives are sent south to slaughter the fleeing Hillsbrad Peasants seeking refuge in the orchards.

sections.title: Sowing Terror in the Fields
sections.body: The campaign against the human presence in Hillsbrad Foothills moves with cold deliberation. After Horde forces strike the northern farms, panic sweeps through the settlement. Rather than taking up arms, many laborers flee southward into the orchards and pastures of Hillsbrad Fields, hoping to hide from the advancing undead. High Executor Darthalia views their terror not with mercy, but as a strategic opening to break Hillsbrad's remaining labor force and morale completely.

sections.title: The Dark Lady's Advance
sections.body: Under direct orders from Tarren Mill, champions of the Horde hunt down these displaced laborers in the fields. Deprived of protection, the peasants are systematically eliminated to choke off Hillsbrad's food supply and shatter civilian resolve. For Darthalia and the Forsaken, every human felled tightens the grip of death around the surviving township, ensuring that Lordaeron remains firmly in the hands of the Forsaken.

faq.q: Why are the Forsaken targeting simple peasants?
faq.answer: Targeting the peasants destroys the agrarian backbone that feeds the Hillsbrad settlement. By killing the laborers hiding in the southern orchards, High Executor Darthalia ensures the town descends further into panic and starves, making ultimate conquest far easier.
High Executor Darthalia, the Forsaken commander stationed at Tarren Mill, commands the entire military effort against the local human settlements in the name of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: Where did these peasants flee from?
faq.answer: They fled from the northern farms of Hillsbrad following earlier Horde strikes. Panicked and defenseless, they took refuge among the trees and pastures of the southern Hillsbrad Fields.

faq.q: Where can the fleeing peasants be found?
faq.answer: The peasants are scattered across the southern orchards and pastures of Hillsbrad Fields, just south of the main road running through the foothills.

faq.q: What comes after killing the peasants?
faq.answer: With the southern fields cleared of laborers, High Executor Darthalia escalates the campaign to target Blacksmith Verringtan and the smithy arming Hillsbrad's defenders, bringing the fight ever closer to the town center.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting so ruthlessly here?
faq.answer: The human town of Hillsbrad represents one of the final remaining Alliance strongholds in Lordaeron. The Forsaken regard the region as their rightful sovereign territory and seek to expel or eliminate any Alliance enclaves that threaten their southern border.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, this purge is practical and uncompromising: eliminating the living laborers denies the Alliance sustenance and cements the Dark Lady's dominion over southern Lordaeron.
Tarren Mill serves as the Horde's vital bastion in the foothills. Breaking Hillsbrad ensures Horde lines of communication and supply remain secure against Alliance incursions.
The slaughter of unarmed refugees in the southern orchards underscores the ruthless, total war waged by the Forsaken against Lordaeron's remaining living subjects.
